title: Atrial fibrillation on apixaban, Vietnamese
source:
DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS
Patient: Nguyen Van Binh   MRN: 55102984
Attending: Dr. Sarah Kim

Diagnosis: New atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response, now rate controlled.

MEDICATIONS
NEW: Apixaban 5 mg by mouth twice daily, about 12 hours apart. Do not skip doses. Do not stop without talking to your cardiologist.
NEW: Diltiazem extended-release 120 mg by mouth once daily.
STOP: Aspirin 81 mg - stop, because apixaban already protects against clots and both together raise bleeding risk.
CONTINUE: Atorvastatin 40 mg by mouth at bedtime.

Bleeding precautions: Use a soft toothbrush and an electric razor. Avoid ibuprofen and naproxen; use acetaminophen for pain.
Return precautions: Call 911 for sudden weakness on one side, trouble speaking, chest pain, or fainting. Go to the Emergency Department for black or bloody stools, vomiting blood, or a head injury.

Follow-up: Cardiology clinic with Dr. Kim in 2 weeks. Primary care in 1 week.
